name: Round Rock
seo_title: Round Rock Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 11 Events, 6 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Round Rock, TX: The Light Park at Dell Diamond, Hometown Holiday lights, Santa's Jingle House, Kalahari Breakfast with Santa and more.
lede: Round Rock does Christmas big for a city its size: a drive-thru light show at the Dell Diamond, a free month of downtown lights and music, Santa in a historic 1870s house, and a free park festival with train rides.
celebrates: December in Round Rock centers on downtown, where Hometown Holiday fills Main Street and Prete Plaza with lights, giant ornaments and live music every night of the month, and Music on Main brings free bands on Wednesdays. Light Up the Lake glows over Old Settlers Park on December 4 and 5. Out by the ballpark, The Light Park turns the Dell Diamond lot into a drive-thru show. In Old Town, Santa's Jingle House fills the historic Owen House with Santa visits and elf hunts, and the Williamson Museum hosts a free Candlelight Christmas with Swedish Julbord tastings.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Round Rock held Light Up the Lake on December 5 and 6 at Bright Lake in Old Settlers Park. Families saw giant illuminated balloons, a light show and a yule log, and the new Lakeview Stage hosted the Elevation Band on Friday and the Austin Symphonic Band on Saturday. Mayor Craig Morgan welcomed guests at 7 pm before the Let There Be Light moment at 7:15 pm.
facts: Round Rock is named for a real rock. Blacksmith Jacob M. Harrell settled on Brushy Creek in 1848, and the little town was first called Brushy Creek. Harrell and postmaster Thomas C. Oatts suggested a new name after a round, table-shaped limestone rock in the creek where they liked to fish, and it became Round Rock on August 24, 1854. Cattle on the Chisholm Trail later crossed the creek right beside that rock.
trains: Trains moved Round Rock. When the International-Great Northern Railroad arrived in 1876, it passed about three quarters of a mile from the old village, so stores moved next to the tracks and that New Town is today's downtown. Capital MetroRail's Red Line has no Round Rock stop; the nearest stations are Howard and Lakeline. Amtrak's Texas Eagle stops in nearby Taylor, and the Austin Steam Train Association runs vintage trains from Cedar Park.
train_links: Vintage train rides from Cedar Park, including the Hill Country Flyer, a 66-mile round trip to Burnet.
traditions: Downtown Round Rock stays lit every night in December with oversized ornaments, gift boxes, archways and live music.
The city's free Wednesday night concert series has played downtown since 2013 and runs through December 23.
Giant lit balloons, a light show and live music over Bright Lake in Old Settlers Park in early December.
A family-run Santa house in the historic Owen House in Old Town, founded in 2015.
The Williamson Museum's free evening of living history, crafts and Julbord tastings at the Old Settlers Association.
Round Rock police have delivered gifts to local families since 1978; 2026 is the 48th year.
kidfact: Round Rock is named after a real round rock. Long ago, people who lived here fished from a flat, round limestone rock in Brushy Creek, and they liked it so much they named the whole town after it. The rock sits in the creek near where cattle drives on the Chisholm Trail once crossed.
faq: What free Christmas events are in Round Rock?

Hometown Holiday lights downtown are free every night in December, with free live music most Tuesdays to Saturdays through December 23. The Williamson Museum's Candlelight Christmas on December 11, Brushy Creek MUD's Holiday in the Park on December 12, Bass Pro's Santa photo and the library's Nutcracker program are free too.
When is The Light Park at Dell Diamond open?

Nightly from November 6, 2026, to January 3, 2027, from 5:30 to 10 pm, and until 11 pm on the busiest nights. Tickets are sold per car, $39.99 on Best Value nights and $49.99 on Popular nights, plus fees and tax.
Where can kids see Santa in Round Rock?

Santa visits Bass Pro Shops through December 24 with a free photo, Santa's Jingle House at the Owen House on Sundays and Christmas Eve, Kalahari's Breakfast with Santa on December 13, and Holiday in the Park at Cat Hollow Park on December 12.
Is there a Christmas train ride near Round Rock?

Holiday in the Park at Cat Hollow Park on December 12 includes free train rides for kids. For a real vintage train, the Austin Steam Train Association runs excursion trains from Cedar Park, including the Hill Country Flyer to Burnet. Amtrak's Texas Eagle also stops in nearby Taylor.
When is Light Up the Lake 2026?

The City of Round Rock lists Light Up the Lake for December 4 and 5, 2026, at Old Settlers Park, with the Austin Symphonic Band on Friday and Sean Ardoin on Saturday. Families can also visit downtown on the way for the Hometown Holiday lights.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Round Rock for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events, 6 of them free. The magic runs from Friday, November 6 through Sunday, January 3, 2027, with The Light Park at Dell Diamond (November 6 to January 3), Hometown Holiday Lights in Downtown Round Rock (December 1 to 31) and Light Up the Lake at Old Settlers Park (Friday and Saturday, December 4 and 5). New in this update: Candlelight Christmas at Old Settlers Association (Friday, December 11), Holiday in the Park at Cat Hollow Park (Saturday, December 12) and the Dance Arts Pflugerville Nutcracker at Hernandez Middle School (December 4 to 6). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Texas Christmas events for kids guide.
